rendered: Production build served on port 3111. Public home at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 px: no horizontal overflow, mark box 46 x 44 px, brand link 44 px tall. Public header rows: 320 and 360 px wrap to two rows as before (89 px); 390 and 430 px stay on one row (72 px) thanks to the 14 px wordmark rule at 430 px and below (without it 390 px wrapped to 89 px).

Signed-in headers (customer and team) were rendered from markup injected into the production build's real CSS, not from a real session, and not through the operator suite. Measured scrollWidth equals clientWidth (no overflow) at 320, 360, 390, 700 and 759 px for both; the wordmark is hidden at all of these widths. Header height: 61 px at 360, 390, 700 and 759 px; at 320 px the 46 x 44 px mark wrapped the row to 113 px (a mark of 44 px wide or more wrapped, 42 px did not), so the mark is 42 x 40 px at 340 px and below, after which the 320 px header is 61 px. Same injected markup with the old 26 px mark: 61 px at 320, 340 and 360 px.

Wide layouts from the same injected markup: customer 1280 expanded, collapsed rail (mark alone) and team 1280: header 64 px, identical with the old 30 and 24 px mark; 768 and 390 px header 61 px, identical with the old mark.
Footer wordmark (reversed on navy) rendered at 1440 px: dots legible.
Favicon files rendered at 3x: favicon-16 orb tile, favicon-32, -48 and -64 halftone tile.

changedArtwork.icon.svg: halftone mark reversed on the navy tile, 0.92 of the tile, 21812 bytes; dot group equals the reversed mark's (test pins it)
changedArtwork.favicon.ico: 16 px entry unchanged (orb); 32 and 48 px entries rasterised from icon.svg
changedArtwork.docs/brand/assets/favicon: favicon.svg, favicon-32, -48, -64 and favicon.ico replaced; favicon-16 unchanged; apple, android and maskable files were already the halftone mark and are unchanged
changedArtwork.public/brand mark files: corridra-mark-cobalt.svg and -reversed.svg are byte-identical to docs/brand/assets/svg (test pins it)

notDone: No real signed-in session was rendered and the operator suite was not run; the signed-in headers and the left rail were checked from injected markup only. Please look at them in the preview.
Open Graph and Twitter images already use the halftone lockup (checked by eye); not regenerated.
Browsers that prefer icon.svg show the halftone at 16 CSS px; only favicon.ico keeps the orb at 16 px.
Trademark check, vector master and legal handoff, tagline review and the art-direction review of the orb as a standalone mark stay open.
